title: Five Easy Steps
hook: A circle with nobody in charge of it.
scene: A single-lane roundabout where the county road meets the state route, and a sedan is already inside it coming around toward your entry. You have never liked these. Yuna says they're the safest intersection anyone builds, which is easy to say on a radio.

source.teaching_target: NEW: PSDP thirteen Lesson one – five easy steps. Prefer PSDP-only (not IV-015 4.15 replay).

image_brief.subject: a single-lane roundabout entry; a sedan already circulating inside toward your entry
image_brief.foreground: worn black wheel, faded pink dash, coarse mesh; closed dark carrier latched and strapped on the passenger floor (Gracie inside; wheels turning)
image_brief.midground: roundabout apron and circulating sedan inside the circle approaching your entry lane
image_brief.background: overcast county/state junction, splitter island, no traffic signal
image_brief.read: a sedan is already inside the single-lane circle coming toward your entry
extra_negatives: no second person in the car
no cat loose on the seat
no "ginger tabby" wording — use orange tabby markings behind the grille
no carrier door facing outboard toward camera
no empty carrier with no cat visible behind grille
no belt not routed through handle
no low dash-level mesh band only
no brightly lit dash by default
no speedlike 112 LCD readout (odo/trip numerals OK if not live speed)

geometry.ego_lane_side: entry lane of a single-lane rural roundabout
geometry.ego_nose_in_frame: plow points up-frame toward the circulating lane

image_brief.standing_carrier_spec: hard-sided; wire grille door facing inboard; Gracie's orange tabby markings visible behind the grille; belt routed through the handle
image_brief.standing_biome: Cascades-west PNW wet backcountry — restricted sightlines, second-growth fir crowding the shoulder, blackberry and alder in the ditch, vegetation close to the road, wet gray asphalt; NOT sage, dry grass, bare hills, or long open highway

variation.forced: Act VI wave-1 briefs landed; stills pending review; do not seed

decision: You're at the entry. A car is already in the circle.

options.text: Slow to about fifteen, yield to him, then take the gap behind
options.result: You come down to fifteen, look left, and let him have it. Then the gap opens and you go without stopping again.

options.text: Stop at the line and wait for the whole circle to clear
options.result: Nobody empties a roundabout. You stop, then stop again, and the three cars behind you inherit it.

options.text: Enter now — you're moving and he can adjust
options.result: He's already in. Traffic in the circle has it, and you just asked a stranger to brake for your entry.

options.text: Enter, then change lanes inside to reach your exit sooner
options.result: Single lane, and you came in planning to move around in there. There is nowhere left to sort it.

debrief: Slow down, look left, yield to traffic already in the roundabout, don't stop inside, and signal your exit.
